text:
Several issues with this:

It should be in mailnews.js with the other OAuth prefs.
At least until we've tested this well, it should be false by default on release channels. Let's use #ifdef EARLY_BETA_OR_EARLIER so we get some beta testing.
As I said in the main comment, I think we can do this cross-platform, so name it something neutral like mailnews.oauth.useExternalBrowser. There's already a usePrivateBrowser, so that fits.
